query:
SELECT
    fuel_measurement_id AS "id: FuelMeasurementId ",
    timestamp,
    fuel_liter
FROM
    active_vessels w
    INNER JOIN fuel_measurements f ON w.fiskeridir_vessel_id = f.fiskeridir_vessel_id
    AND call_sign = $1
WHERE
    (
        $2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
        OR timestamp >= $2
    )
    AND (
        $3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
        OR timestamp <= $3
    )
ORDER BY
    timestamp DESC
LIMIT
    $4
OFFSET
    $5
